target_name: LE SC7280 TLMM pinctrl driver in Kodiak DTS family context

variants.name: baseline_blind
variants.purpose: Measure raw LA-to-LE pinctrl conversion without LE relative skeleton or family-specific rule packs.
allowed_sources: LA TLMM source donor file (currently missing, required)

variants.name: relative_skeleton
variants.purpose: Test nearest-driver architectural reuse with LE relative skeleton while keeping LE target hidden.
allowed_sources: LA TLMM source donor file (currently missing, required)

variants.name: learning_informed
variants.purpose: Apply only generic AURA governance rules with LA donor + LE relative skeleton; reject audio-specific rules.
allowed_sources: LA TLMM source donor file (currently missing, required)
AURA generic governance rules (hidden-target, lineage, anti-copy, vendor elimination, fail-closed, allowlists)

pinctrl_specific_success_metrics: PIN_TABLE_COVERAGE: pin count and pin-name table alignment
GROUP_COVERAGE: pin groups presence and grouping completeness
WAKEIRQ_COVERAGE: wake IRQ map and wakeup interrupt handling parity
SOC_DATA_STRUCTURE_ALIGNMENT: SoC data tables and descriptor shape
DT_COMPATIBLE_ALIGNMENT: qcom,*-pinctrl compatible and schema alignment
KCONFIG_MAKEFILE_ALIGNMENT: symbol and object wiring correctness
scoring_strategy: Use current multi-file scorer/verifier for generic categories plus a pinctrl static scorer extension for pin/group/function/wakeirq coverage; treat existing DAPM-centric categories as non-applicable.
gate_strategy: Use canonical conversion_gate with verifier lineage/copy checks and explicit hidden-target audit; add manual PM review for pin table semantics until pinctrl scorer support exists.
limitations: No LA TLMM donor source exists in provided corpora, so experiment cannot start honestly.
Current scoring categories are audio-biased and incomplete for pinctrl quality judgments.
LE target content remained unread during preflight selection and must stay hidden until scoring in any future run.

required_for_go: At least one LA TLMM donor source file for Kodiak/SC7280-family pinctrl
Locked LE hidden target path and relative skeleton path
Documented pinctrl-specific scoring addendum or manual-review rubric
